target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, disposable VirtIO disk clone, graphical terminal
result: pass: stock DiskRaw showed the drive report and both class reports, accepted block 1, dumped the GPT signature, restored the drive's original range, and returned to a terminal that evaluated 40+2 as 42; zstatus failed=0
setup: The harness creates a RedSea fixture on a disposable disk clone, explicitly mounts the read-only D bridge, and temporarily selects it as the task current drive before launching the original source via XTalk. It is not automatic OS drive discovery.

color_followup.result: pass: green last_time field recognized using a lower brightness threshold; GPT dump, terminal recovery and restored drive range also passed

limits: This checks one read on one PCI VirtIO fixture. The drive report lists only bridge-registered drives, and the custom VirtIO type is not integrated into stock block-device registries. Filesystem operations, writes, generic mounting, other device types, hotplug, Pi storage and live UTM/Pi remain unverified. Green class-field labels are visible in the framebuffer but omitted by the monochrome OCR used by the automated checkpoint.
